## At a glance

- **Covers.** [[Session 1 - Recap]]: the ferry grounding, the fire on Pier Row and the fight in the lamp room.
- **Ends on.** One bell stroke from the flats near [[Reedholt]], at dawn.
- **Leads into.** [[Session 2 - Prep]].

> [!narration] Previously on
> You came into Saltwick on a ferry that ran aground when the lighthouse went dark. The Harbor Warden, Hobb Tarrow, hired you to keep the lamp burning through the Long Ebb, and the same night goblins burned the oil warehouse on Pier Row. You saved half the barrels and carried workers out of the smoke. At the lighthouse you found Ilse Corran in the lamp room. She was calm and polite, and she offered to pay for darkness. You refused. She fell back through the window on a rope with an arrow in her arm, and you lit the lamp again. Hobb lent you an old brass lantern and a purse of coin. You stood on the gallery in the grey of dawn, and far out on the flats a bell rang once. Hobb said he had never heard it before the Long Ebb.
